messages.content: Write a very long story about a dragon, at least 2000 words.

The sky above the Valley of Whispers did not change with the seasons as the rest of the world did; it changed with the mood of the creature that roamed its highest peaks. For millennia, the air here had been thick with the scent of ozone and ancient stone, but for the last three hundred years, it had carried the metallic tang of blood and the acrid sting of sulfur. This was the era before the Great Silence, a time when dragons were thought to be myths told by children to frighten them into obedience, or perhaps just forgotten legends whispered in taverns by drunkards seeking warmth.

But Elara was no myth. She was the last of her kin, or so the records claimed. Or at least, she was the only one who remembered what it felt like to be truly alive, not just a vessel for fire and scales, but a creature with a heart that could ache and a soul that could question.

Elara stood upon the jagged spine of Mount Cinder, her massive wings stretching out until they touched the cloud layer below. She was ancient, her scales a mosaic of obsidian black and iridescent violet that shifted color with the angle of the sun.
